items.prompt: A club has boys and girls in the ratio 4 to 5. There are 45 children in the club. Build the model and say what one unit is worth.
hints: The ratio 4 to 5 gives boys 4 units and girls 5 units.
items.explanation: 45 divided by 9 is 5, so one unit is 5 children. There are 20 boys and 25 girls.

items.prompt: Lea has blue and green beads in the ratio 3 to 7, and 60 beads in all. Build the model and say what one unit is worth.
hints: The ratio 3 to 7 gives blue 3 units and green 7 units.
items.explanation: 60 divided by 10 is 6, so one unit is 6 beads. Blue is 18 beads and green is 42 beads.
